show.description: A gripping tale of love, betrayal, and hidden identities,Hidden Crorepati follows Tanya, a secret tycoon posing as a receptionist, and Rajvir, a conflicted CEO. A fake marriage turns real amid power struggles and heartbreak. After tragedy and a shocking truth, Rajvir lives as a janitor—until his past returns, forcing him to confront love, loss, and destiny.
